svg.title: K1198 Run G (21G) Plc1m c sheet: c and ca-cz, font v7.1 v7.2 Plc1m
svg.text: K1198 Run G (21G) Plc1m c sheet: c and ca-cz, font v7.1 v7.2 Plc1m
Columns: the font (wght 100), then each build over a pale copy of the font. Black bodies, red solved joins, blue preset joins, orange lead-ins and tails. Units: 1 px = 1 u (x-height 120 u).
